setup.title: Library Setup

setup.name: Name

branch.heading: Branches
branch.description: Each library location. Copies belong to a branch and can be sent between them.

type.heading: Membership types
type.description: How many items a member may borrow, for how long, and what a late day costs.
type.sameTitleWait: Days before the same title can be reserved again
type.sameTitleWaitHint: A member who has a title on loan must wait this many days from the issue date before reserving it again. 0 means no wait.
type.hint: Changes apply from the next issue, renewal and return. Due dates already given stay as they are.

staff.title: Branch staff
staff.explain: Staff listed here can only issue, shelve, receive and reserve at this branch (and any other branch they are listed under). Staff listed under no branch can work at every branch. Anyone who can change library setup is never limited.
staff.none: Nobody is assigned, so any staff member can work here.
staff.search: Search users by name or email…

titles.title: Import catalogue
titles.intro: Bring your existing book list in from Excel or CSV — one row per title, or one row per title at each branch.
titles.matching: A row with the same ISBN — or the same title and author — as a book already here adds copies to it. Running a file again never doubles anything.

members.title: Import members
members.intro: Bring your existing member list in from Excel or CSV — one row per member.
members.matching: A row with the same card number — or the same email, or name and phone — as someone already here is skipped. Running a file again never creates duplicates.

import.drop: Choose an Excel or CSV file
import.dropHint: or drop it here. The first row must be the column headings.
import.needHeader: The file needs a heading row and at least one row of data.
import.defaultBranch: Branch for rows that name none
import.defaultBranchHint: Used when the Branch column is empty or not in the file.
import.createBranches: Create branches named in the file that do not exist yet
import.defaultType: Membership type for rows that name none
import.defaultTypeHint: A type named in the file must already exist under Branches & Rules.
import.branchesCreated: New branches created from the file: {{count}}
import.fixAndRerun: Correct those rows in the file and import it again — rows already imported are skipped.

reminders.heading: Member reminders
reminders.description: Emails sent to members automatically: before an item is due, when it is overdue, and when a reserved book is ready.
reminders.noEmailServer: This server has no email account set up, so reminders cannot be sent yet. You can still choose the settings and preview what would go out.
reminders.enableHint: Due and overdue notices go out once a day, in the morning. Ready-for-pickup notices go out within 15 minutes.
reminders.overdueEveryHint: The first goes the day after the due date. 0 = none.
reminders.overdueMaxHint: After this many, the library follows up by hand.
reminders.timeZoneHint: Decides what counts as today for due dates.
reminders.notifyReady: Email the member when a reserved copy is ready to collect
reminders.previewHeading: Emails that would be sent now: {{count}}
reminders.sentWithFailures: Sent {{sent}}; {{failed}} could not be sent — see the log below.
reminders.sendBody: Every member with something due soon, overdue or ready to collect is emailed now. Anyone already reminded is not emailed again.

toast.copySent: Copy sent — it shows as in transit until it is received.
toast.reserved: Reserved "{{title}}" — the member is in the queue.

print.scaleNote: In the print window, set Scale to 100% ("Actual size") and margins to None — otherwise the labels drift off the stock.

labels.title: Print barcode labels
labels.capped: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}. Narrow the filter to print the rest.
labels.unreadable: Barcodes that cannot be printed as bars (non-English characters): {{count}}. Their number prints as text only.
labels.skipHint: On a part-used sheet, printing starts after these.

cards.title: Print member cards
cards.unreadable: Card numbers that cannot be printed as a barcode: {{count}}. The number prints as text only.

portal.heading: Member portal
portal.description: A page where members see their books, renew them and reserve titles, using their card number and a PIN.
portal.enabledHint: Only members you have given a PIN can sign in.
portal.allowRenewalsHint: The usual renewal limits still apply.
portal.allowReservationsHint: The usual reservation limits still apply.
portal.publicCatalogueHint: Without signing in. Titles and availability only — never member details.
portal.linkHint_one: Share this address with your members. {{count}} member has a PIN.
portal.linkHint_other: Share this address with your members. {{count}} members have a PIN.
portal.linkCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.

member.heading: Online access
member.has: This member has a PIN for the member portal.
member.none: This member cannot sign in to the member portal yet.
member.replaceBody: {{name}}'s current PIN will stop working, and they will be signed out of the portal.
member.removeBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in to the member portal. Their loans and reservations are not affected.
member.pinOnce: Give these to the member now. The PIN is not stored in a readable form and cannot be shown again — if it is lost, give a new one.

finance.title: Post collected fines to Finance
finance.subtitle: One draft journal entry for the fine payments not yet in the accounts.
finance.throughHint: Payments taken on or before this day.
finance.nothing: Everything collected up to this day is already in the accounts.
finance.receivedInHint: Debited. Usually cash on hand or a bank account.
finance.incomeHint: Credited. An income account for fines and fees.
finance.noAccounts: Finance has no active accounts yet. Set up the chart of accounts first.
finance.sameAccount: The two accounts must be different.
finance.draftNote: The entry is created as a draft in Finance, where an accountant reviews and posts it. These payments are then marked so they cannot be posted twice.
finance.nothingToPost: There is nothing to post, or the accounts are not chosen.
finance.postFailed: Finance did not create the journal entry. Nothing was posted.
finance.markFailed: Draft journal entry {{number}} was created in Finance, but the payments could not be marked as posted ({{error}}). Delete that draft entry in Finance before trying again, or the same money will be entered twice.
